summary: Iteration 19: verified login-activity audit + Cashier scan-URL flow. Backend pytest (6/6 pass): superadmin GET /api/users/login-activities returns safe fields only and includes the fresh super login; role=admin and role=kasir both receive 403 on that endpoint; POST /api/vouchers returns scan_url ending with /kasir?scan=<code> plus a valid qr_code base64; kasir can redeem an active voucher exactly once (2nd attempt -> 400 'sudah pernah digunakan'); unauthenticated redeem -> 401. Frontend smoke (Playwright, desktop + 390px mobile): (a) Signed-out visit to /kasir?scan=TEST123CODE redirects to /login?next=%2Fkasir%3Fscan%3DTEST123CODE (next preserved). (b) Super sees the 'Aktivitas Login User' card on /admin/users (data-testid=login-activities-card); after ~1s the table populates via /api/users/login-activities. (c) A temp role=admin user on /admin/users does NOT render the activity card (correctly gated by isSuper). (d) /kasir renders qr-reader with zero <select> children inside #qr-reader (no camera-choice selector). Source uses Html5Qrcode.start with facingMode {exact:'environment'} directly, so back camera is the only constraint. In the preview browser without camera hardware the UI shows the localized error 'Kamera belakang tidak tersedia. Gunakan Ketik Kode.' with a retry button — expected in headless env. (e) No pageerror or runtime exception on scanner start/stop; only benign 401s from /api/auth/me during the pre-login state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now >1080 lines; recommend modularizing (routers/auth.py, routers/vouchers.py, routers/users.py, services/email.py). Same concern flagged in prior iterations.
record_login_activity currently only records success events; no failure logging. If auditability of failed attempts becomes a requirement, extend after the 401 branch in POST /api/auth/login.

get_login_activities safely projects out _id and password/pin hashes; response shape is {items:[{user_id,name,role,status,logged_at}]} — matches Super-Admin-only requirement (require_role(['superadmin'])).
build_voucher_scan_url correctly honours x-forwarded-proto/host so vouchers created behind the ingress produce absolute https URLs. Good.

CashierMode.getVoucherCode robustly handles a URL payload (extracts ?scan=...) and falls back to legacy raw-code payloads; scan-URL flow is idempotent thanks to quickScanRef and setSearchParams({replace:true}) deleting the ?scan param post-redemption.

Html5Qrcode.start uses facingMode {exact:'environment'} and no camera-picker UI is created; matches spec. However 'exact' constraint will hard-fail on devices without a rear camera (front-only laptop/tablet). This is intentional per PRD but may surprise admin users testing on desktop — the localized error already communicates it.
LoginPage handleLogin validates the next path with startsWith('/') && !startsWith('//'), preventing open-redirect via '//evil.com'. Good.
UserManagement fetches /api/users/login-activities only when isSuper is true and hides the card for non-super users — matches spec on both server AND client sides.
